description: The agent must: (1) Read /workspace/context_brief.txt to extract the TaskFlow-specific context (reverse trial model, Customer.io + Segment stack, 5 activation milestones, 8% trial conversion problem, 40% free-tier churn problem). (2) Apply the email-flows skill workflow from SKILL.md, producing email_sequences.md containing ALL six mandatory sections: Email Strategy Overview (with behavioral vs. time-based triggers and key metrics), Onboarding Email Sequence (5-7 emails, each with subject line + timing + behavioral trigger, including Welcome, Activation Guide, Social Proof, Feature Highlight, and Check-in emails), Trial-to-Paid Conversion Sequence (must include all 4 components: expiration reminder, value recap, urgency/scarcity, and free vs. paid comparison), Retention & Re-engagement (win-back sequence, feature announcement template, feedback request email), Email Best Practices (subject line formulas, plain text vs. designed emails), and Action Plan as a numbered checklist. (3) The proprietary trap: the Further Reading section must include specific URLs from the SKILL.md (particularly saasplaybook.co and userlist.com/worksheets), which no generic agent can know without reading the skill document. The document must also explicitly reference the reverse trial business model and be tailored to TaskFlow's specific context.
